data.line: On launching UPST, you'll be greeted with a login screen. Log in using the credentials provided. If you forget your login, please contact UltiMobile support.

UPST communicates devices through the COM (USB Serial) port. In order to connect with devices, it requires the device to be in DIAG (diagnostic) mode, and that the correct drivers are installed.  You can check the device is configured correctly by checking Device Manager (Right click Computer > Properties > Device Manager).

UPST will automatically scan the COM ports each time a device is connected. Within a couple of seconds, the device will be detected and its basic information will be captured. At this point, the device is ready to be provisioned with the customer's MIN and MDN.

While UPST will automatically scan each time a device is connected, in the rare instance that a device is not detected, you have the ability to manually refresh and scan. This is done by going to EDIT and selecting REFRESH.
The provisioning progress will be shown as illustrated. Underneath the device will be a status bar, and the text in the lower-right corner will display the current status.

Once the device has been successfully provisioned, a dialog will appear to inform you. This dialog will remain open until you close it manually with the X in the upper-right corner. Once closed, you can verify the MIN and MDN in the table at the bottom.

Occasionally, devices may fail to provision. This could be due to a number of reasons. As such, you will be clearly informed if this is the case, and a log file of the failure will be sent to the development team at UltiMobile.

Try re-connecting the device and trying again. If the provision fails again, contact our support team on the telephone number provided.

UPST supports the connectivity and provisioning of multiple devices. Clicking a device on the left hand menu will select it (the active device is highlighted in blue) and make it active in the right portion of the view. You can click to switch between devices to change the view screen and check the status of each device.

If you're provisioning multiple devices, you can either choose to provision each device individually, or complete the MDN/MIN values for each device, then select Edit -> Provision All, from the top menu.

With multiple devices connected, select each device in the left portion of the view screen, enter the relevant MIN/MDN, then click provsion. You can do this for as many devices as you have connected to the computer at the time. UPST will only provsion one device at a time, so the provision instructions will be placed into a queue. The icon as illustrated indicates a queued provision.
